create_causal_4d_mask: create a causal 4D attention mask of shape (batch_size, 1, query_length, key_value_length) for transformer models
convert_2d_to_4d_mask: convert a 2D attention mask to a 4D attention mask for multiplication with attention scores
prepare_causal_sdpa_mask: prepare a causal attention mask for use with PyTorch's scaled_dot_product_attention function
ignore_causal_mask_sdpa: detect whether a causal attention mask can be ignored to dispatch to flash attention kernel in SDPA
unmask_unattended_tokens: unmask unattended token rows in expanded attention mask for left-padding with SDPA memory-efficient path
